T1.name: full AdamW vs bias-corrected m/v rewrite
T1.covers: non-constant LR, non-zero decay, masked param groups, clip active/inactive, restored step count (t_warm=46), first-step a=0/b=0 no div-zero

T2.name: realized d_t carry-over identity
T2.covers: non-constant P and eta; negative variants (P_prev substitution, double eta) both deviate and fail

T3.name: full-state + log-LR analytic tangent vs central FD
T3.covers: PD quadratic training loss, V with different Hessian, clip inactive (rel 2.3e-9) and active, v>0 strict; v=0 boundary guarded (r=0 when m=0; BOUNDARY_V_ZERO flagged when m!=0, finite)

T4.name: training-field mu vs validation q separation
T4.covers: e_m recursion == m_hat - mu (from step 20, filter-gain identity), readout W_field+W_track+W_wd == W_total at places=12 with PRE-update theta, q<->mu swap changes semantics

T5.name: clip order asymmetry
T5.covers: C(E[g]) != E[C(g)] concrete counterexample (g1=(2,0), g2=(0,2), tau=1); noncommuting clip-JVP J and Hessian H: JH-(JH)^T nonzero

T6.name: update nonlinear expectation
T6.covers: two-point c in {1,3}; mean(u_map(g)) != u_map(mean g) at module level (tau=1e12 clip-inactive)

T7.name: quadratic valley pulse4 reversal (exact numbers)
T7.note: only shows reversal does not require crossing valleys; NOT the Transformer mechanism

T8.name: prediction adapters positive/negative controls
T8.covers: no-clip quadratic: Mgeom E<1e-12 (FP64 exact), M0 E==1; clip active-set change: real re-clip accurate (<1e-9), fixed clip-JVP finite displacement fails (>0.3); smooth non-quadratic: Mgeom NOT exact (E>1e-6) -- falsifiable

T9.name: readout & RNG
T9.covers: two-step telescope; K_V allowed negative; module functions consume no RNG and do not mutate inputs (unit-level guard; smoke re-checks on GPU)
